coordinateSummary.warning: All newly created positions are development-stage corridor reconciliations. They must be replaced with exact authoritative stop coordinates without changing composite IDs.

topologyDecisions: Lines 016, 018 and 052 are each stored as two independently ordered open patterns.
All six patterns use closesLoop false; no reverse sequence or last-to-first edge is inferred.
Lines 016 and 018 share the complete Cala Finestrat–Benidorm–La Nucia trunk but diverge after Polop toward Guadalest and Fonts de l’Algar.
Line 052 remains a shorter Callosa–Polop–La Nucia–Benidorm service rather than being concatenated with either long-distance route.
Shared terminals may end one direction and begin another without converting the pair into a closed cycle.
identityDecisions: All accepted shared StopNodes and StopPlaces are copied exactly from prior Benidorm scenarios.
NUC directional pairs and repeated CV-70 names remain distinct because their operator codes differ.
GUA 1110 and GUA 1111 remain separate C/ Aitana directional identities and are not merged with GUA 30.
CSA 50 and CSA 51 remain separate Fonts de l’Algar and Dinopark identities.
Every new StopNode receives a singleton StopPlace; proximity and matching names do not merge identities.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty for new nodes because no individual OSM platform or stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.

reviewItems.detail: Replace all 31 newly created development positions with exact authoritative coordinates while preserving composite IDs and cross-package exact equality.
Confirm the operator’s canonical machine prefixes for page-rendered numeric codes 1110–1118 and 1124–1125. Current namespace normalization is source-context based and recorded explicitly.
The current 2026 route page was cross-checked against a complete 2025 official print sequence. Recheck for route drift if a newer complete printable capture becomes available.
